Mechanism: mesa-sponsor-fold
How: a lotus clerk keeps one mesa roster of 12 sponsors; a new key may join only if it shares at most 3 of them for 8 epochs.
Cost: the 4th shared sponsor burns 1.7 payout and the 5th burns 2.4, then that key holds 0.35 quorum for 6 epochs.
Check: close folds two keys when their sponsor sets overlap on 4 names inside the hollow window.
